title: Leonora Carrington's birth chart
metaDescription: Leonora Carrington's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 16.1° Aries. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled stand in Aries — the Sun, Mercury, Venus and Mars. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 16.1° Aries, inside the second decan (10°–20°), whose traditional sub-ruler is the Sun. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Aries (24.5°), Venus in Aries (11.0°), Mars in Aries (8.3°): thought that arrives already in motion, attraction declared rather than implied, effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts Mercury at right angles from Saturn, 0.7° off exact. Right angles are where the scheme puts its grit. A square asks two functions to work in a mode neither would have chosen. Behind it, Mercury sextile Uranus at 1.8°, and Venus conjunction Mars at 2.6° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: Jupiter makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, four placements stand out. The Sun in Aries at 16.1° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Aries at 11.0° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Aries at 8.3° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Cancer at 23.8° is in detriment. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements fire 5, water 2, earth 1, air 1; modalities cardinal 6, fixed 3. Neptune was retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Virgo into Libra during that day at the birthplace, travelling 12.4° between one midnight and the next. A birth time would settle it in a second; there isn’t one. So the Moon stays unnamed here — the alternative is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact.
